title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
Theorie
RTC beschrijft bewuste ervaring als een resonantietoestand van een gekoppeld oscillatorveld. De theorie is opgezet om doorrekenbaar te zijn: elke stap hieronder heeft een module in de suite.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
Het uitgangspunt
Waarneming is niet ogenblikkelijk. Wat als één moment wordt ervaren, bestrijkt een interval van enkele tientallen milliseconden. RTC neemt dat interval, de perceptuele tijdsdrempel \tau, als vertrekpunt in plaats van als meetartefact.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
Vier aannames

Het brein bevat een groot aantal oscillatoren met uiteenlopende eigenfrequenties.
Die oscillatoren zijn onderling gekoppeld met een sterkte K die kan variëren.
Bewuste toegang hangt samen met de mate van fasesynchronisatie, gemeten als ordeparameter R.
Aandacht werkt niet als extra signaal maar als regelaar van K.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
De ordeparameter
In de mean-field vorm van het Kuramoto-model vat één complex getal de toestand van het hele veld samen:
z = \left\langle e^{i\theta_j} \right\rangle, \qquad R = |z|, \qquad \Psi = \arg(z)
\frac{d\theta_i}{dt} = \omega_i + K R \sin(\Psi - \theta_i)

kuramoto <- function(N = 50, K = 2.0, dt = 0.01, steps = 2000, sd_omega = 0.5) {
  set.seed(42)
  omega <- rnorm(N, 0, sd_omega); theta <- runif(N, 0, 2 * pi)
  R_hist <- numeric(steps)
  for (s in seq_len(steps)) {
    z <- mean(exp(1i * theta)); R <- Mod(z); Psi <- Arg(z)
    theta <- theta + dt * (omega + K * R * sin(Psi - theta))
    R_hist[s] <- R
  }
  R_hist
}
plot(kuramoto(), type = "l", ylim = c(0, 1), col = "#00549c",
     xlab = "iteratie", ylab = "ordeparameter R")
abline(h = 0.6, lty = 2, col = "#0099c8")







Figuur 1: Ordeparameter R(t) bij K = 2, N = 50 oscillatoren.





Wanneer K oploopt, blijft R eerst laag en ruisig en klapt daarna binnen korte tijd omhoog. Die scherpe knik is het kandidaat-mechanisme voor het aan-of-uit-karakter van bewuste toegang.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
Van synchronisatie naar energie
Een veld dat over een venster \tau fase-informatie integreert, kan per tijdseenheid 1/\tau onafhankelijke toestanden onderscheiden. Neem aan dat dit in drie onafhankelijke richtingen gebeurt, en de mentale energie schaalt met de derde macht van die frequentie:
E_m = \frac{1}{\tau^3}
De exponent volgt dus uit de aanname over dimensionaliteit, niet uit een fit. Dat maakt hem toetsbaar: een gemeten helling die duidelijk van -3 afwijkt, weerlegt de aanname en niet alleen de parameter.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
Wat er openstaat

De meetprocedure voor \tau is niet geijkt tussen laboratoria.
De eenheid van E_m is niet vastgelegd, waardoor alleen verhoudingen zinvol zijn.
De koppeling tussen R en gerapporteerde ervaring is correlationeel; het model geeft nog geen onafhankelijke voorspelling die de gangbare alternatieven uitsluit.

Die drie punten zijn de reden dat de rekenmodules op deze site openstaan. Wie de aannames wil testen, heeft de code nodig — niet alleen de conclusie.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
1 Introduction
The Resonance Theory of Consciousness (RTC) proposes that Prima Experientia is the ontological substrate of reality.
Observable perception is generated through a discrete psychophysical sampling process governed by the Psychophysical Time Quantum (PPTQ).
The relation between Mind-Energy and PPTQ is
E_m=\frac{1}{T^3}
where

T = PPTQ (seconds)
E_m = Mind-Energy.



2 Interactive RTC Simulator
The simulator below is implemented in Streamlit.




3 Mathematical Model


Show R/Python code
import numpy as np

pptq = 65      # milliseconds

T = pptq/1000

Em = 1/(T**3)

print("PPTQ:",pptq,"ms")
print("Mind-Energy =",Em)


PPTQ: 65 ms
Mind-Energy = 3641.3290851160673




4 Resonance Function
RTC assumes that resonance unfolds continuously.


Show R/Python code
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

pptq=65

T=pptq/1000

time=np.linspace(0,2,3000)

signal=np.sin(2*np.pi*time/T)

plt.figure(figsize=(12,4))
plt.plot(time,signal)
plt.xlabel("Time (s)")
plt.ylabel("Resonance")
plt.title("Continuous Prima Experientia")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()











5 Constructed Temporality
Perception is assumed to arise through sampling of continuous experience.


Show R/Python code
sample_times=np.arange(0,2,T)

samples=np.sin(2*np.pi*sample_times/T)

plt.figure(figsize=(12,4))
plt.plot(time,signal,color="gray")

plt.scatter(sample_times,samples,
            color="red",
            s=40)

plt.xlabel("Time (s)")
plt.ylabel("Experience")

plt.title("Sampling of Prima Experientia")

plt.grid(True)

plt.show()











6 Mind-Energy Curve


Show R/Python code
pptq=np.linspace(20,200,400)

T=pptq/1000

Em=1/(T**3)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))

plt.plot(pptq,Em)

plt.xlabel("PPTQ (ms)")

plt.ylabel("Mind-Energy")

plt.title("RTC Equation")

plt.grid(True)

plt.show()











7 RTC State Space


Show R/Python code
states=["Psychosis",
        "Healthy",
        "Meditation",
        "Depression",
        "Deep Sleep"]

pptq=[20,
      65,
      80,
      130,
      10000]

energy=1/((np.array(pptq)/1000)**3)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))

plt.bar(states,energy)

plt.ylabel("Mind-Energy")

plt.title("RTC Mental States")

plt.xticks(rotation=25)

plt.show()











8 Ontological Operators
RTC proposes four ontological operators
M_{exp}
=
\alpha I
+
\beta C
+
\gamma R
+
\delta V
where

I = Inertia
C = Cohesion
R = Radiation
V = Vibration

These operators continuously generate Prima Experientia.


9 Conclusions
The integration of Quarto and Streamlit enables an interactive scientific publication in which theory, mathematical derivations, simulations and visualizations coexist in a single document.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
Theory
RTC describes conscious experience as a resonance state of a coupled oscillator field. The theory is built to be computable: every step below has a module in the suite.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
The starting point
Perception is not instantaneous. What is experienced as one moment spans an interval of a few tens of milliseconds. RTC takes that interval, the perceptual time threshold \tau, as its point of departure rather than as a measurement artefact.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
Four assumptions

The brain holds a large number of oscillators with differing natural frequencies.
Those oscillators are mutually coupled with a strength K that can vary.
Conscious access relates to the degree of phase synchronisation, measured as order parameter R.
Attention acts not as an extra signal but as a controller of K.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
The order parameter
In the mean-field form of the Kuramoto model a single complex number summarises the state of the whole field:
z = \left\langle e^{i\theta_j} \right\rangle, \qquad R = |z|, \qquad \Psi = \arg(z)
\frac{d\theta_i}{dt} = \omega_i + K R \sin(\Psi - \theta_i)

kuramoto <- function(N = 50, K = 2.0, dt = 0.01, steps = 2000, sd_omega = 0.5) {
  set.seed(42)
  omega <- rnorm(N, 0, sd_omega); theta <- runif(N, 0, 2 * pi)
  R_hist <- numeric(steps)
  for (s in seq_len(steps)) {
    z <- mean(exp(1i * theta)); R <- Mod(z); Psi <- Arg(z)
    theta <- theta + dt * (omega + K * R * sin(Psi - theta))
    R_hist[s] <- R
  }
  R_hist
}
plot(kuramoto(), type = "l", ylim = c(0, 1), col = "#00549c",
     xlab = "iteration", ylab = "order parameter R")
abline(h = 0.6, lty = 2, col = "#0099c8")







Figure 1: Order parameter R(t) at K = 2, N = 50 oscillators.





As K rises, R first stays low and noisy and then jumps within a short time. That sharp knee is the candidate mechanism for the on-or-off character of conscious access.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
From synchronisation to energy
A field integrating phase information across a window \tau can distinguish 1/\tau independent states per unit time. Assume this happens along three independent directions, and mental energy scales with the third power of that rate:
E_m = \frac{1}{\tau^3}
The exponent therefore follows from the dimensionality assumption, not from a fit. That makes it testable: a measured slope clearly departing from -3 refutes the assumption, not merely the parameter.

title: Resonance Theory of Consciousness
text:
What remains open

The measurement procedure for \tau is not calibrated across laboratories.
The unit of E_m is not fixed, so only ratios carry meaning.
The link between R and reported experience is correlational; the model does not yet yield an independent prediction that rules out the standard alternatives.

Those three points are why the computing modules on this site are open. Anyone who wants to test the assumptions needs the code, not only the conclusion.

title: Edward F. Hillenaar
text:
In my practice Totale Gezondheid I work with EMDR and mindfulness; alongside that I write the Resonance Theory of Consciousness, an attempt to make conscious experience computable as a resonance state.
Those two tracks sit closer together than they appear. In practice I see daily that the width of the experienced now changes under stress, attention and training. In the theory that same width is the quantity on which the model stands or falls.

title: Edward F. Hillenaar
text:
Why this site
Because a theory resting on formulas should also be inspectable as formulas. Everything here is runnable: the modules execute real R code in your browser, and every article comes from a Quarto document whose calculations ran at render time.
Responses, objections and measurement data are welcome. Objections especially: the three open points in the theory chapter have not become smaller since I wrote them down.

title: The Resonating Self
text:
The threshold that sets everything
The perceptual time threshold \tau is the shortest duration within which two stimuli are still experienced as one moment. In RTC that threshold is not a by-product of perception but the base unit of the model.
E_m = \frac{1}{\tau^3}
The same five measurements produce a paradox on a linear scale, and a straight line with slope -3 on a log-log scale.

tau <- c(0.100, 0.080, 0.062, 0.050, 0.042)
Em  <- 1 / tau^3
fit <- lm(log(Em) ~ log(tau))

plot(log(tau), log(Em), pch = 19, col = "#0099c8",
     xlab = "ln tau", ylab = "ln Em")
abline(fit, col = "#00549c")







Figure 1: Mind-Energy law: log-log check across five perceptual states.





The slope comes out at -3, as the law predicts.

A check across five states

summary(fit)


Call:
lm(formula = log(Em) ~ log(tau))

 2.151e-16 -1.204e-16 -4.494e-16  3.787e-16 -2.400e-17

log(tau)    -3.000e+00  5.270e-16 -5.692e+15   <2e-16 ***
---
Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

Residual standard error: 3.682e-16 on 3 degrees of freedom
Multiple R-squared:      1, Adjusted R-squared:      1 
F-statistic: 3.24e+31 on 1 and 3 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16


The slope comes out at -3; deviations larger than 0.1 in practice point to a measurement error in \tau, not an error in the law.

plot(log(tau), log(Em), pch = 19, col = "#0099c8",
     xlab = "ln tau", ylab = "ln Em")

title: The Mind-Energy law and the third power
text:
What it does not say
The law describes a scaling relation, not an absolute quantity. Without a calibrated unit for E_m only the ratio between two states carries meaning — which is exactly what the log-log form makes measurable.

title: The Resonating Self
text:
De drempel die alles bepaalt
De perceptuele tijdsdrempel \tau is de kleinste duur waarbinnen twee prikkels nog als één moment worden ervaren. In RTC is die drempel geen bijproduct van waarneming maar de basiseenheid van het model.
E_m = \frac{1}{\tau^3}
Dezelfde vijf metingen leveren op een lineaire schaal een paradox op, en op een log-log-schaal een rechte lijn met helling -3.

tau <- c(0.100, 0.080, 0.062, 0.050, 0.042)
Em  <- 1 / tau^3
fit <- lm(log(Em) ~ log(tau))

plot(log(tau), log(Em), pch = 19, col = "#0099c8",
     xlab = "ln tau", ylab = "ln Em")
abline(fit, col = "#00549c")







Figuur 1: Mind-Energy-wet: log-log-controle op vijf perceptuele toestanden.





De helling komt uit op -3, zoals de wet voorspelt.

title: De Mind-Energy-wet en de derde macht
text:
Wat het niet zegt
De wet beschrijft een schaalverhouding, geen absolute hoeveelheid. Zonder een geijkte eenheid voor E_m blijft alleen de verhouding tussen twee toestanden zinvol — en dat is precies wat de log-log-vorm meetbaar maakt.
